name: PT Anabatic Technologies Tbk
summary: PT Anabatic Technologies Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides cloud and digital platform solutions and services in Indonesia and internationally. It operates through Digital Enriched Outsourcing Services, Cloud and Digital Platform Partner, and Others segments. The company offers system integration, implementation, and maintenance services; business process outsourcing services; infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and IT managed services; employee and customer experience services; Customer Experience-as-a-Service (CXaaS); Business Process-as-a-Service (BPaaS); and IT solution services.
